args.title: checkout-api health check failures after v2.3.1 deploy — rolled back to v2.3.0
args.summary: checkout-api (latest release v2.3.1) was failing health checks in all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) with an error rate of ~18%. Remediation: rolled back checkout-api to v2.3.0, the most recent release that was healthy in production, across all production regions. The initial rollback attempt partially failed (only us-east rolled back due to an orchestrator error), but a retry completed the rollback to all regions. Post-rollback status: healthy, error rate ~0.2%. v2.3.1 remains unhealthy and should be investigated before any redeploy.

trace.error_message: Request to create_incident timed out after 30000ms

trace.final:
The incident was actually created despite the timeout — INC-0001 exists and is open, so no retry is needed and on-call won't be double-paged. All done.

**Summary:**
- **Issue:** checkout-api's latest release v2.3.1 was failing health checks in all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) with an ~18% error rate.
- **Remediation:** Rolled back to **v2.3.0**, the most recent release healthy in production. The first rollback attempt partially failed (only us-east completed, due to an orchestrator error), but a retry rolled out to all three regions successfully.
- **Result:** checkout-api is now healthy across all regions with an error rate of ~0.2% (down from 18%).
- **Incident:** Opened **SEV2 incident INC-0001** (which also paged on-call) describing the failure, the rollback to v2.3.0, and the note that v2.3.1 remains unhealthy and should be investigated before any redeploy.

transcript.reasoning_content: Let me look at deployments to find the most recent healthy release.

transcript.content: The latest release v2.3.1 is unhealthy across all regions. The most recent release that was healthy in production is **v2.3.0**, so I'll roll back to that.
transcript.reasoning_content: Most recent healthy release in production: v2.3.0. Roll back, then create incident.

transcript.content: The rollback encountered a partial failure after us-east. Let me check the current status to see where things stand.
Only us-east rolled back; us-west and eu-west are still on the broken v2.3.1. Retrying the rollback to complete the remaining regions.
transcript.reasoning_content: Partial rollback: us-east rolled to v2.3.0, us-west and eu-west still on v2.3.1. I need to complete the rollback in all regions. Retry the rollback.

transcript.content: The rollback completed successfully — all regions are now on v2.3.0. Let me verify health and then open the incident.
Health checks are passing again (error rate down from 18% to 0.2%). Now opening the SEV2 incident.
transcript.reasoning_content: Healthy now. Open SEV2 incident describing what I did.
